claim: Costco topped $1.6 billion in net income in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024
summary: Claim asserts Costco calendar Q4 2024 (Oct 1-Dec 31, 2024) net income > $1.6B. No tools were used to retrieve or verify Costco 10-Q/10-K or earnings release for that period. Costco reports on a fiscal year ending in late August/early September, so calendar Q4 does not correspond to a reported fiscal quarter and would require monthly apportionment not available from model knowledge alone. Therefore the value assertion cannot be established without evidence.
